result_row.claim: Recorded, not asserted -- section 2 gives S13 no threshold. Over job 298712: two selfplay stages of 6.25 s and 6.95 s produced 80 games and 2534 rows (31.675 rows/game); two train stages of 139.03 s and 136.61 s each ran one epoch of 38 batches at batch 32, so the wall time is dominated by torch.compile (mode=default) and not by the 1216 samples; two shuffle stages of 3.35 s each; one gatekeeper stage of 70.19 s for 156 games at 150 visits with one real net. Peak VRAM 4094 MiB on a 180 GB B200 and GPU utilisation max 80 % / mean 21.5 % over 170 samples -- the single-GPU duty cycle that DESIGN section 1's [PRELIMINARY] starvation argument and claim c09 need. Peak RSS per stage: gatekeeper 4.55 GB, train 3.43 GB, selfplay 1.76 GB, shuffle 39 MB, against 8.48 GB for the whole job (seff) and 64 GB requested. Storage: 353.8 bytes per row on disk against 2145 uncompressed, a compression factor of 6.06 that the 500 GiB budget arithmetic should use; the whole two-cycle BASEDIR is 97 MB.
